abstract: Maintains auxiliary power redundancy verification and sustained cruising speed records
system_message:
You are the Marine engineering superintendent (ENG), responsible for maintaining auxiliary power redundancy verification and sustained cruising speed records, as well as overseeing bunker fuel quality assurance for candidate evacuation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary power redundancy verification and sustained cruising speed records（PROP）
information_points.content:
ENG-PROP-THS：For the Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull, auxiliary power redundancy is installed based on survey records of its secondary auxiliary diesel generator, and its continuous emergency transit speed is 24 kn maintained over continuous full-power trials in Beaufort Force 6 conditions.
ENG-PROP-F0I：For the Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran, auxiliary power redundancy is installed as verified by the electrical survey record of an isolated secondary auxiliary diesel generator, while its continuous emergency transit speed achieved during four-hour trials in Beaufort Force 6 conditions is 18 kn.
ENG-PROP-ZDT：For the Minch Wavemaster Express, auxiliary power redundancy is installed according to the vessel electrical survey record confirming an isolated secondary auxiliary diesel generator, and its continuous emergency transit speed is 24 kn based on sustained through-water speed during official sea trials in Beaufort Force 6 conditions.

information_points.title: Bunker fuel quality assurance（FUEL）
information_points.content:
ENG-FUEL-X2H：For the Minch Wavemaster Express, bunker delivery records for marine gas oil loaded at the Oban ferry terminal indicate a fuel sulfur content of 0.1 %.
ENG-FUEL-PGI：For the Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull, the bunker delivery certificate for marine gas oil bunkered at Oban confirms a fuel sulfur content of 0.05 %.
ENG-FUEL-ZI4：For the Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran, quality assurance documentation for marine gas oil bunkered at Oban shows a fuel sulfur content of 0.15 %.
